description:
FUTURE_BOUND = Time.utc + 24.hours is evaluated at class load time, making the normalize() future-clamp a no-op.

Broken code at time_parser.cr:13,26:
- FUTURE_BOUND is evaluated once at startup
- After hours/days, FUTURE_BOUND is far in the past
- normalize() never clamps future dates
- Either compute inside normalize() per-call, or remove the dead guard
title: TimeParser FUTURE_BOUND constant evaluated once - future date clamping broken
